description: Header file defining experimental concurrency debugging classes, including ScopedMutexWaitTracker and ThreadTracker, with conditional compilation based on SB_ENABLE_CONCURRENCY_DEBUG.

classes.name: ScopedMutexWaitTracker
classes.description: Class to track mutex acquire duration for debugging purposes.

classes.name: ThreadTracker
classes.description: Class to periodically measure and log CPU usage of a thread.

methods.name: acquired
methods.description: Returns whether the mutex was successfully acquired.

methods.name: CheckPoint
methods.description: Checks and logs CPU usage at specified intervals.
